diagnostics.message: local_file.private_ssh_key has an explicit `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` attribute already references `tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem`, which establishes the same dependency implicitly. The depends_on is redundant.

local_file.public_ssh_key has an explicit `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` attribute already references `tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh`, which establishes the same dependency implicitly. The depends_on is redundant.

The runner instance's user-data (held on aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance) writes the real registration token into aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token, which Terraform creates with the placeholder value "null" (and only ignores later value changes). Nothing orders the SSM parameter before the launch configuration/instance, so the instance's user-data can run before the parameter exists (causing a create conflict) or Terraform can create the parameter afterward and clobber the token. aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance should depend on aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token.
